exercises.instruction: You talked to some friends of yours. The descriptions show what they said (direct speech). Later the same day you tell another friend what they said (reported speech). Complete the sentences.

items.cue: 🚉 You: Shall we walk to the station? — Tom: No, it’s too far. Let’s get a taxi.
parts: I wanted to walk to the station, but Tom said

items.cue: 🎉 You: Have you been invited to the party? — Anna: Yes, but I don’t want to go.
parts: Anna has been invited to the party but she told me

items.cue: 🧳 You: When are you going away, Dan? — Dan: I’ll let you know next week.
parts: I asked Dan about his travel plans. He said

items.cue: 👩 You: Do you ever see Rachel these days? — Ben: I haven’t seen her for a while.
parts: I asked Ben about Rachel, but he told me

items.cue: 🎸 You: Where can I borrow a guitar? — Kate: You can borrow mine.
parts: I needed to borrow a guitar and Kate said

items.cue: 💼 You: How’s your job, Sue? — Sue: I’m not enjoying it very much.
parts: I asked Sue about her job. She said

items.cue: 🚗 You: Do you still have your car? — James: No, I sold it a few months ago.
parts: I asked James about his car. He told me

items.cue: ☕ You: What’s the name of the café we went to? — Sarah: I don’t know.
parts: I asked Sarah the name of the cafe we went to but she said

items.cue: 🏫 You: How many students are there in your class, Amy? — Amy: Twenty.
parts: I asked Amy about her school and she told me
answers: (that) there were twenty students in her

exercises.instruction: Somebody says something to you which is not what you expected. Use your own ideas to complete your answers.

items.prompt:
a: It's quite a long way from the hotel to the city centre.
b: Is it? The man on the reception desk said it was only five minutes' walk.

a: Sue is coming to the party tonight.
b: Is she? I saw her a few days ago and she said she …
modelAnswers: wasn't coming / was going somewhere else / couldn't come

items.prompt:
a: Sarah gets on fine with Paul.
b: Does she? Last week you said … each other.
modelAnswers: they didn't like each other / they didn't get on with each other / they couldn't stand each other

items.prompt:
a: Joe knows lots of people.
b: That's not what he told me. He said … anyone.

a: Jane will be here next week.
b: Oh, really? When I spoke to her, she said … away.
modelAnswers: she would be away / she was going away

items.prompt:
a: I'm going out tonight.
b: Are you? I thought you said … at home.

a: I speak French quite well.
b: Do you? But earlier you said … any other languages.
modelAnswers: you couldn't speak / you didn't speak

items.prompt:
a: I haven't seen Ben recently.
b: That's strange. He told me … last weekend.
modelAnswers: he'd seen you / he saw you
